name: Mercado Pago API
tagline: Latin American payments API for checkout, wallets, and marketplace payouts
description: Mercado Pago (Mercado Libre) payments platform API for accepting cards, Pix, boleto, and local methods across LATAM; create preferences, process payments, manage customers, refunds, and subscriptions via REST with OAuth/access tokens.

auth.details: Bearer access token (test or production) in Authorization header; obtain via developer panel app credentials or OAuth for marketplace integrations

pricing.free_tier_limits: API access free; transaction fees apply per payment method/country (see pricing by country)
pricing.paid_plans: Per-transaction merchant fees; no API subscription tiers documented

use_cases: create checkout preference for a cart
process a card payment with token
list available payment methods by country
